text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haff, haff, haff, haff, haaahh...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you, Doto. Why don't you rest over 
there for a bit? I'm going to run one more 
lap.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ye-es! O-O-Opera O-san, you're still going 
to do more...?!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! —My beloved co-stars are all 
truly exceptional, fully worthy of my 
recognition, after all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even I don't believe that the leading role 
would simply fall from the sky without any 
effort.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Risking one's all, scaling the mountain 
peak named hardship, and seizing it with 
one's own hands.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've resolved to 'definitely 
achieve it'—that's precisely why I am a 
born Overlord!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Now then, shall we begin? —For 
the Satsuki Sho is drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah— Whew.
Ah! ...Ayabe-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back! Ehehe, I heard you went out 
for roadwork, so I was waiting here for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Need something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I definitely have business with you, 
Ayabe-san! It's about tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Would you mind running alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Top Road-senpai!! ...And Ayabe-senpai 
too!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Are they going to run alongside each other 
now? Whoa, I'm so curious...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
When people think of Ayabe-senpai, they 
think of a cool genius! She's always been 
amazing, but—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Still, Top Road-senpai's been in amazing 
form lately too! So maybe...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Alright. Shall we get started, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

And so, the two of them, Admire Vega and 
Narita Top Road, began their workout 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah--

First to step forward was Narita Top Road. 
Admire Vega held back, running from 
behind.

Admire Vega's strength lies in her 
razor-sharp late-stage burst. Therefore, 
her usual tactic was to make a move on the 
final stretch and blow past everyone, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —...gh, right here!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

—Unable to catch Narita Top Road, who made 
an early spurt, Admire Vega allowed her to 
cross the line first...

text_block_list.name: Ayabe & Top Road
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh, all right!! Yes, yeaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You look happy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah. Ah, haha... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but... honestly, I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san. Because I wanted to beat you—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've come this far because, no matter 
what, I wanted to defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've researched you, thoroughly! And from 
that, I came to fear your late-race surge 
to the utmost—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Then, what should I do so I won't get 
caught?" "How can I win?" I racked my 
brain even harder thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been doing some pretty gritty 
training so I don't burn through my 
stamina even if I make my move early.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, no matter what... Ayabe-san. I 
wanted to beat you."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......I don't really understand.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's—um.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Ayabe-san, do you have any plans after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To thank you for matching paces with me on 
such short notice, please let me treat you 
to a meal!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I guess I'll go with the Carrot 
Hamburg Steak Set after all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
At places like this, no matter how big the 
menu is, you always end up ordering the 
same classic you've had before.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...A familiar story.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, on the other hand, seems to 
jump right in and try all the new menu 
items! Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oops, what will you have, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Steamed chicken salad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, a steamed chicken salad and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, just a salad?! Uh, you really don't 
have to hold back, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it. ...More 
importantly, didn't you come here to 
talk?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah. ...Ehehe, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, as for why I'm so fixated on 
Ayabe-san—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Because I respect them.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Respect...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm always thinking, 'I absolutely want to 
live up to everyone's expectations.'

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Having people cheer for me and wanting to 
see me win makes me feel so happy... and 
so very proud.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the more desperately I want to 
live up to those hopes, sometimes—”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There are times when my legs freeze, even 
amidst the cheering.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...And because of that, I ended up letting 
down all their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, after talking with Ayabe-san at the 
Hopeful Stakes and watching you run ...I 
understood.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even if my legs tremble from the pressure, 
even if I'm terrified of letting everyone 
down, even so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
As long as my resolve never wavers, having 
decided that 'I will absolutely live up to 
expectations.' My legs will keep moving 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You were the one who taught me that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san. I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will be taking the Triple Crown. Because 
'I want to live up to everyone's 
expectations, no matter what.'

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: That's why, first at the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat you—the one I respect so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...—At that moment...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Struck straight through by those earnest, 
steadfast eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (My cheek stung ever so slightly.)
Big sis...?
